I need to determine the additional clockwise angle in degrees, relative to the reference image, that aligns the target object's facing direction with the reference direction.

The reference direction is indicated by the finger in image 1, which is pointing downward. Looking at the current object in image 2, its facing direction is lower-right.

The reference angle is 270 degrees (downward). The current angle is 135 degrees. The difference is 135 - 270 = -135 degrees. Since the result is negative, I need to add 360 to it, resulting in 225 degrees.
